title: Garmin Multisport Activity Daily Event Volume
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:multisport
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(activity_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Garmin multisport activity events land each day and how many distinct activity type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Garmin multisport activity records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct activity type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much Garmin multisport activity activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
